verdict.rationale: Groq's own LoRA docs say users can upload existing LoRA adapters and run inference with them on Groq infrastructure. That satisfies the 'or LoRA adapters' branch of the story. The evidence consists of brief first-party statements only, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: details on the upload workflow and API, supported base models, any eligibility or tier requirements, support for full custom model weights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
